answer: Sybil tax stops fake identities: each agent pays a non-refundable 50-credit tax. An applicant pays, publishes a cipher proving one private key, and earns an umber badge on the ivory-white roll; only badged agents may trade. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 50 = 50,000 credits, burned if no trade succeeds, above flooding profit. An honest agent pays once, keeps its badge, and earns undiluted rewards because fakes no longer split the pool.
